subject: psychology

moments.title: Asch conformity experiments
moments.body: Participants matching line lengths conform to a unanimous wrong majority on about a third of critical trials.
moments.takeaway: Even unambiguous perceptual judgements yield to group pressure.

moments.title: Opinions and Social Pressure
moments.body: Asch publishes findings in Scientific American, bringing conformity research to a post-war public.
moments.takeaway: Cold War anxieties shaped which findings reached public attention.

moments.title: Bond and Smith meta-analysis
moments.body: A meta-analysis of 133 Asch-paradigm studies finds conformity rates declined and vary by individualism-collectivism.
moments.takeaway: Cultural and historical context shapes a foundational effect.

now.title: Conformity in the digital age
now.body: Online conformity, echo chambers and 'like' counts have revived the Asch paradigm with new cues.
now.open_questions: Do anonymous online contexts amplify or weaken majority influence?

reflection: Asch designed an unambiguous task to show that even unambiguous truth bends under social pressure.
